name: smart-whatsapp-service
description: Standalone, always-on Node service that connects a real WhatsApp Business App number via WhatsApp Web pairing (unofficial — see README) and bridges it to the main Wokbook backend. Deploy this separately (VPS/Node hosting, e.g. Hostinger) — it cannot run as a Vercel serverless function because it has to hold a live connection open 24/7.

scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/routes.js && node --check src/session-manager.js && node --check src/backend-client.js && node --check src/config.js
